* 
 ORDER
The Project Director, National Highways, Krishnagiri, is suo motu impleaded as second respondent in this writ petition.
2. Mrs.S.R.Sumathy, learned standing counsel, takes notice for the impleaded second respondent.

3. This writ petition has been filed seeking issuance of a writ of mandamus directing the respondents to pass orders on the appeal/claim made by the petitioners under Section 3(G)(5) of the National Highways Act.

4. Heard Mr.G.M.Ananthakumar, learned counsel for the petitioners, Mr.P.Sathish, learned Additional Government Pleader appearing for first respondent and Mrs.S.R.Sumathy, learned Standing Counsel appearing for second respondent.

5. In the instant case, the award was passed in the case of the first petitioner on 27.07.2022 and in the case of the second petitioner on https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 12/03/2025 01:26:30 pm ) 21.09.2021.
Not being satisfied with the quantum of compensation, the petitioners have filed an appeal/claim before the first respondent under Section 3(G)(5) of the National Highways Act on 06.12.2024.
Since the same was not considered, the present writ petition has been filed.

6. Taking into consideration the facts and circumstances of the case and the materials placed before this Court, there shall be a direction to the first respondent to deal with the appeal made by the petitioner on its own merits and in accordance with law and pass final orders within a period of twelve (12) weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order after affording opportunity to the petitioners and the impleaded second respondent.
This writ petition is disposed of with the above direction.
No costs.
